name: M5.RepairSupport.replacement_combined_gcd
statement: ∀ (A B : Finset ℕ) (e q : ℕ), M5.RepairSupport.combinedGcd (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e q) B = Nat.gcd q (Nat.gcd ((A.erase e).gcd id) (B.gcd id))
guidance: Unfold combinedGcd and repaired. Finset.gcd_insert gives gcd of q and the erased support gcd, with id q=q. Reassociate using Nat.gcd_assoc. Gcd insertion is idempotent, so this identity requires neither membership nor freshness. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
